description: Permanent source of truth for verified Semitic Jew project work that may not create repository commits.

fieldDocumentation.confirmedUpdate: A factual update confirmed by the project owner or a public repository record; leave empty when none is recorded.
fieldDocumentation.status: One of not_reported, planned, active, blocked, completed, or ongoing.
fieldDocumentation.date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the confirmed update, or null when no dated update is recorded.
fieldDocumentation.publicLink: Public HTTPS link when one exists, otherwise an empty string.
fieldDocumentation.blocker: Confirmed blocker, or an empty string.
fieldDocumentation.nextAction: Confirmed next action, or a prompt to record one.
fieldDocumentation.subscriberAppropriate: True only when the confirmed update is suitable for a public newsletter.
